summary.main: Senior Full-Stack Developer and Software Architect with 10+ years of experience delivering robust enterprise platforms and ERP systems across front-end and back-end architectures. Advanced expertise in back-end engineering with C# and .NET Core, paired with deep front-end and server-side proficiency in TypeScript across modern browser environments (React) and Node.js runtimes. Demonstrated success implementing SOLID Principles, Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) to build scalable, high-availability solutions utilizing Docker and Microsoft Azure. Proven track record directing the end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC) from architectural design through automated cloud deployment.
highlights: Strong C# and .NET background, including .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, Entity Framework Core, WCF, WPF, and WinForms. Experienced in solution architecture and system design using SOLID principles (Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, and Dependency Inversion), Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS), N-Tier architecture, API Gateway, and RESTful API patterns.

Hands-on experience building service-oriented and event-driven backends with RabbitMQ, MassTransit, Ocelot API Gateway, JWT authentication, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Docker, Microsoft Azure, CI/CD pipelines, OpenTelemetry, and Serilog.
Full-stack development experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Vue.js, Angular, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, and cross-platform mobile development using Dart and Flutter.

Known for leading projects from concept, requirements analysis, and system design through full-stack implementation, testing, cloud deployment, release management, documentation, troubleshooting, and production support.
Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate - 2025.

items: SOLID Principles (SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP, DIP)

experience.role: Senior Software Developer and Software Architect
tasks: Architected and delivered full-stack .NET and React/Angular TS solutions with SOLID principles and Clean Architecture, CQRS, and DDD; migrated legacy monoliths to microservices, cut time-to-market by 39% and post-release defect density by 60%.

Built AI-integrated frontend platforms using React + Vite/Vitest with RAG and an autonomous agentic layer, raising query result accuracy up to 95% while sustaining 85%–100% test coverage; extended reach via responsive browser extensions.

Automated the complete software delivery lifecycle by establishing multi-stage CI/CD pipelines, containerization with Docker, reducing production deployment duration from 15 minutes down to 3 minutes / by 80%.

Engineered core enterprise modules and business logic for the flagship Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform utilizing ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, WCF, and WinForms with DevOps, boosting daily processing efficiency by 5%.
Developed 3 interactive React.js front-end modules and 3 cross-platform Flutter mobile modules, consuming RESTful APIs to streamline operational workflows across the ERP platform.

Contributed and Delivered modules spanning Stock Management, Order Management, Procurement Management, Shipment Management, Wholesale Sales Management, Retail Sales Management, Cost Management, and Production Management.

Built automated enterprise background processing engines and Windows Services in C# (.NET Framework/.NET) using plugin architecture, integrating Azure Blobs, File Share, Tables, and MS SQL for cloud-based persistence, increasing automated task throughput by 5%.

Modernized legacy .NET Framework 4.6.2 applications to .NET 7 by refactoring legacy code, upgrading dependencies, and adopting dependency injection. Reduced recurring maintenance effort by ~10–15%, improved security through then-supported runtime patches, modern cryptography, and secure-by-default configurations, and 1.5–2x higher throughput in targeted benchmarks.
Built end-to-end web and desktop applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, MVC, WPF, and WinForms, transitioning legacy monolithic codebases into scalable Service-Oriented Architectures (SOA).

Engineered Laravel/Lumen REST APIs on MySQL for mobile and Content Management System (CMS) backends—auth, profiles, push, in-app purchases, publishing, media, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)—reducing average API response time by 20%.
Designed optimized database schemas and relational indexes across MySQL and SQLite, reducing expensive table scans and improving query performance by 45%.

Contributed on a 9-person engineering team, maintained and optimized enterprise-scale Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), and Card Management System web applications using ASP.NET WebForms and DevOps, resolving business-critical bottlenecks to ensure seamless transactional processing across card lifecycle, customer, and merchant operations.

Authored and tuned 30+ MS SQL Server stored procedures for financial reporting on a prepaid card platform; implemented idempotent retry and restart logic for daily card load and batch jobs, significantly reducing manual recovery effort.
Modernized a legacy ASP.NET WebForms financial dashboard by migrating to DevOps Web Forms Controls, implementing server-side data binding and adaptive rendering for responsive cross-device access.

Engineered full-stack web applications across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC), delivering responsive, cross-browser compatible interfaces using JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3, with back-end services built on PHP, Laravel, and MySQL.
Implemented automated cloud deployment pipelines using Microsoft Azure and Heroku, reducing manual software release turnaround time from 10 minutes to 3 minutes, a 70% reduction.

Designed and maintained full-stack web applications and client interfaces within a 8-member cross-functional engineering team, leveraging Git, Jira, and Asana to deliver 13 production applications from concept to release.

Administered relational database lifecycles and web servers (IIS, Apache), implementing structured schema backups, disaster recovery strategies, and virtual machine configurations to ensure continuous availability.
Delivered customer-focused technical solutions and architectural documentation, converting design specifications into scalable production code across 10 successful client application releases.

projects.name: Distributed File Fragmentor
description: Architected a distributed file storage system using .NET 9, Clean Architecture and SOLID Principles to fragment large files, distribute them across multiple storage providers (FileSystem, Database), and verify integrity with SHA-256.
Implemented a CQRS pattern with a source-generated Mediator and engineered a robust batch processing system with isolated DbContext scopes to handle parallel operations safely and efficiently.
Integrated advanced resilience patterns, including exponential backoff retries and circuit breakers, and implemented security measures against path traversal and symlink attacks.

projects.name: SystemProcesses
description: Designed and implemented a high‑performance Windows system monitor and task manager providing hierarchical process views and real‑time resource metrics (CPU, memory, I/O, storage).
Optimized performance with zero‑allocation pathways and thread‑safe data structures, reducing GC overhead and ensuring responsive UI under heavy system load.
Integrated tray enhancements and storage statistics modules for holistic monitoring and quick access to system metrics.
Developed advanced management tools (process termination, elevation, inspection) with safeguards to maintain system stability and compliance.
Architected a modular, maintainable desktop solution using .NET WPF and MVVM, aligned with enterprise‑grade development practices and open‑sourced under MIT license.

projects.name: Meeting System
description: Architected a full-stack meeting system with a .NET 9 Clean Architecture (Api, Business, Context, Model) on EF Core 9 and SQL Server with Repository/Unit of Work, an Angular 20 standalone frontend using RxJS vm$ view models and JWT route guards; the entire stack in Docker Compose (single command) with Swagger/OpenAPI endpoints, health-check endpoints, and a Bogus-seeded dataset; tested with 96 NUnit/Testcontainers backend tests against a real SQL Server instance and 145 Karma/Jasmine frontend unit tests.

projects.name: Notification System
description: Architected a .NET 10 microservices platform migrating an 8-project N-Tier solution to a 22-project multi-layer Clean Architecture with CQRS, DDD, and a shared kernel (`DomainEvent`, `IRequest`, `IDomainEventDispatcher`); diagnosed an exchange-naming defect silently discarding every RabbitMQ event, restoring 100% delivery via a real-broker integration guard.

Enforced quality with 392 TUnit tests and 15 ArchUnitNET rules making architecture drift build-breaking; closed 2 Critical defects (DI dependency failure, redaction bypass) proven via mutation testing, shipped Dockerized non-root images via GitHub Actions CI/CD with a 0-warning Release build.

projects.name: Linguistics (High-Performance Arabic NLP Library)
description: Authored a zero-allocation Arabic Natural Language Processing (NLP) library in C# supporting .NET 6 to 10 with zero external dependencies.
Engineered performance-critical hot paths using `Span<T>`, `stackalloc`, and integer-packed lookup tables to achieve high throughput for search indexing workloads.
Implemented advanced diacritic removal and regex-free text sanitization algorithms, improving execution speed compared to standard Regex-based engines.

projects.name: App User Data Scanner (High-Performance Directory Crawler)
description: Developed a multi-threaded system directory scanner using .NET 10 and NativeAOT for rapid Chromium and Electron profile identification.
Architected a non-blocking producer-consumer pipeline using `System.Threading.Channels` and `Parallel.ForEachAsync` to traverse folder structures with low resource overhead.
Optimized path parsing to minimize heap footprint by leveraging `ReadOnlySpan<char>`, `FrozenDictionary`, and object pooling for zero-allocation hot paths.

projects.name: Data Import/Export Viewer (WPF Tabular Data Application)
description: Built a WPF desktop data viewer supporting streaming import and export operations across CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML, and YAML formats.
Implemented memory-efficient data streaming using `IAsyncEnumerable<T>`, OpenXmlReader, and zero-allocation span-based CSV line parsing.
Designed a clean, decoupled MVVM architecture using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm, featuring virtualized DataGrid elements for smooth rendering of large-scale tabular datasets.

projects.name: Aided
description: Authored and published a minimal, zero-dependency JavaScript library (5.92kb) for building reactive user interfaces without a Virtual DOM, leveraging an ownership graph for automatic memory cleanup.

Engineered an asynchronous longest increasing subsequence (LIS) algorithm using **Web Workers** for non-blocking DOM reconciliation, alongside a high-performance, headless list virtualizer (`VirtualFor`).

Hardened library security with proactive XSS mitigations, implementing URL protocol blocking (e.g., rejecting `javascript:` on sensitive attributes), automatic event-handler binding validation, and strict tag-name validation.
Integrated a zero-overhead performance profiler, scheduler error isolation, and `createResource` cancellation utilizing `AbortSignal` API hooks.
Established a comprehensive testing infrastructure incorporating automated Vitest unit tests and **TestCafe** end-to-end (E2E) browser testing implementing the Page Object Model.

projects.name: Semantic Tool Router
description: Architected a semantic tool-routing CLI that solves the "fat agent" tool-catalog problem by indexing tools offline and injecting only the top-K relevant schemas at runtime via just-in-time context injection.

Implemented a multi-signal retrieval pipeline combining dense cosine similarity, structural intent detection, and keyword-overlap scoring with Reciprocal-Rank Fusion to improve routing accuracy and reduce token bloat.

Designed a polarity-aware vector store that stores positive and negative embeddings per tool, supports model/dimension validation, threshold-based confidence filtering, and JSONL persistence for fast local routing workflows.
Built a data-driven intent layer that compiles tool-specific triggers and boosts at runtime, with builtin verb baselines and longest-match disambiguation to avoid hardcoded tool-name routing.

projects.name: Personal Website: Personal Website & AI Chat Assistant (RAG)
description: Built a bilingual (EN/TR) React 19 data-driven SPA featuring a client-side RAG engine on `MiniSearch` with dual-mode FAQ/cross-locale retrieval, a `puter.js` streaming AI assistant with automatic multi-model fallback across 20+ models, non-blocking context compaction at 75% of the active context window with exponential backoff, real provider token telemetry, lazy PII hydration, strict Content Security Policy (CSP), and a 3-tier system prompt that prevents LLM over-claiming.

projects.name: Architectly (AI-Powered Document Generator)
description: Developed a client-side, AI-powered BRD/PRD document generator built entirely on strict TypeScript, SCSS, and Vite, featuring 100% offline-first execution.
Engineered a custom, SolidJS-style reactive state management system using lightweight signal primitives (`signal`, `computed`, `effect`) to coordinate application view updates.
Implemented client-side persistence using IndexedDB (up to 100 documents with FIFO eviction) and localStorage, integrated with Puter.js AI endpoints gated by AbortControllers.
Designed an accessible UI complying with WCAG 2.1 AA standards, incorporating focus traps, keyboard navigation, and multi-language support (EN/TR/AR) with dynamic RTL rendering.

projects.name: MCP CLI (Model Context Protocol Client)
description: Authored a lightweight, type-safe command-line interface (CLI) for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers using TypeScript and the official `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`.
Designed a stateful background daemon mode utilizing platform-specific sockets (Unix Domain Sockets and Windows Named Pipes) to persist active sessions across CLI invocations.
Engineered client-side policy guards (tool allowlists/denylists, resource access validation, and payload size restriction) alongside JSONPath filtering (`--select`) for response processing.

Established a multi-platform release pipeline using Bun compiler and GitHub Actions to automate cross-compilation, signing, and integrity verification (SHA-256) for Windows, macOS, and Linux binaries.

projects.name: Sinav Oluşturma (Exam Management System)
description: Developed a full-stack exam management system using a clean N-Tier architecture to logically separate the API backend, business logic, and data access layers.
Implemented a secure, role-based authentication system with JWT to provide distinct permissions and application views for Admin and standard User roles.
Integrated a web scraping module using HtmlAgilityPack to dynamically extract and import content for exam creation, demonstrating practical data extraction skills.

projects.name: Exchange (Real-time Exchange Rate Tracker)
description: Engineered a real-time data pipeline using WebSockets to stream live currency updates from a .NET Core backend to a responsive Vue.js client.
Implemented Redis for high-performance in-memory caching, dramatically reducing database load and enabling high-frequency, low-latency data updates.
Developed a multi-component system including a secure RESTful API with JWT authentication and a separate background service to simulate market data fluctuations.

projects.name: Market (Customer Management System)
description: Developed a full-stack customer management application using a clean N-Tier architecture, leveraging the NHibernate ORM for robust, object-oriented data access.
Built a feature-rich and responsive single-page application (SPA) with Angular 11 for comprehensive data management, including interactive data grids with ag-Grid.
Designed and implemented a clean RESTful API to serve as the communication layer between the Angular frontend and the .NET backend, ensuring seamless CRUD operations.

projects.name: SevenZipRunner
description: Built a lightweight .NET library for invoking 7‑Zip from managed code, exposing a simple asynchronous API for both compression and extraction.

Implemented platform-aware executable resolution and runtime tuning to select the correct 7‑Zip binary for Windows/Linux and x86/x64, while automatically adjusting compression settings to avoid 32-bit memory issues.
Created named compression profiles such as Balanced, Fastest, MaxCompression, and LogArchiving to configure compression level, thread count, and process priority per workload.
Added structured error handling with a custom SevenZipException that includes exit code, standard error output, and the exact 7‑Zip arguments used on failure.

projects.name: MCP Hub Web Interface
description: Built a zero-build, production-ready web dashboard for monitoring and managing MCP Hub servers, providing real-time server status, capability counts, uptime tracking, and management actions through a Spotify-inspired UI.

Implemented a transparent Koa-based API forwarder that proxies /api/servers/* requests to MCP Hub on port 3000, preserving query strings and returning graceful 502 errors when the backend is unreachable.

Developed inline capability execution for tools, resources, and prompts with dynamic form generation from JSON schemas, dual modal workflows, and execution statistics tracking per server and system-wide.
Designed a secure client-side interface with XSS-safe rendering via escapeHtml(), responsive card-based layouts, and CSS variables architecture for scalable theming and consistent styling.

sections.title: 1. Who We Are
sections.content:
This website (“we”, “our”, “us”) is operated by Ahmet FATIHOGLU, based in Istanbul, Turkey.  
For Turkey, we are the **Data Controller** under Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK).  
For the EU/EEA, we are the **Data Controller** under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: 2. What Data We Collect
sections.content:
We collect data when you:

- **Submit a contact form**: Name, email, message
- **Use the AI chat**: Your messages, document context (resume/projects/FAQ), conversation history (stored in browser session), and token usage metrics

We do **not** use cookies, tracking technologies, or analytics. We use browser localStorage to remember your language preference, and sessionStorage to persist your chat consent choice within a browsing session.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
sections.content:
We use your data to:

- Respond to your inquiries via contact form
- Process and respond to AI chat messages (sent to Puter.ai LLM API)
- Summarize conversation history for context compaction (sent to Puter.ai)
- Maintain chat session state during your visit

sections.title: 4. How Your Data is Processed
sections.content:
**Static assets**: GitHub Pages (global CDN)  
**Form data**: Forminit (EU/US) — [Privacy Policy](https://forminit.com/privacy-policy/) ● [Terms & Conditions](https://forminit.com/terms-conditions/)  
**Chat messages**: Puter.ai (US) under Standard Contractual Clauses — [Privacy Policy](https://puter.com/privacy) ● [Terms of Service](https://puter.com/terms)  
**Chat compaction**: Puter.ai (US) — conversation history sent for summarization  

We operate no servers. All data processing is handled by the above third-party processors.  
Our form processor **Forminit** is the new name for Getform.io. The platform rebranded from Getform to Forminit in January 2026. All features, accounts, and data carried over — the service is the same, with a new name and continued improvements. Forminit has been operating since October 2015 and is used by companies including Burger King, Volkswagen, Toyota, Lidl, and CodeAcademy.  
Learn more: [https://forminit.com](https://forminit.com)

sections.title: 5. Legal Basis for Processing
sections.content:
- **GDPR (EU/EEA)**: Processing is based on your consent (Article 6(1)(a)) and/or our legitimate interest in responding to your request (Article 6(1)(f)).
- **KVKK (Turkey)**: Processing is based on your explicit consent and/or the necessity to fulfill your request under Article 5(2).

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
sections.content:
We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined above, unless a longer retention period is required by law.  
Chat session data is stored in your browser session only and is cleared when you close the browser tab. Your language preference persists via localStorage across sessions. Your chat consent choice is stored in sessionStorage and cleared when the browsing session ends.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.content:
Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

- Access the personal data we hold about you
- Request correction or deletion of your data
- Withdraw your consent at any time
- Object to processing or request restriction of processing
- Clear your chat history by refreshing the page
- File a complaint with the relevant data protection authority

For Turkey, you may exercise your rights under **KVKK Article 11** by contacting us.

sections.title: 8. International Data Transfers
sections.content:
Your data may be transferred to and processed in countries outside your own:

- **Puter.ai** (US) — chat message processing and model fallback  
- **Forminit** (EU/US) – form submission processing  

We rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for EU-US transfers and ensure compliance with applicable data protection laws including KVKK Board decisions on cross-border transfers.

sections.title: 9. AI Chat Specifics
sections.content:
When you use our AI chat:

- Your messages and document context (resume, projects, FAQ) are sent to Puter.ai LLM API
- We may route through multiple model providers for reliability
- Conversation history is sent for background compaction when context limits are reached
- No conversation data is used to train AI models
- Chat data is session-only and cleared when you close the browser
- **Special category data**: Do not share health, biometric, or political opinion data. If you do, you consent to its processing solely for responding to your inquiry.

sections.title: 10. Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our website is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us for deletion.

sections.title: 11. Automated Decision-Making
sections.content: We do not use automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal or similarly significant effects.

sections.title: 12. Contact Us
sections.content:
If you have any questions about this Privacy Notice or how we handle your data, please contact:  
**Ahmet FATIHOGLU**  
Email: ahmet.fatihoglu.89@gmail.com  
Address: Istanbul, Turkey

sections.title: 3. Disclaimer
sections.content: Information on this website is provided "as is". The site owner makes no warranty regarding the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of information.

sections.title: 4. AI Chat Service
sections.content: The AI chat feature on this site uses a third-party AI provider (Puter.ai). Before using the chat, you must explicitly consent to the processing of your personal data and messages by checking a consent checkbox. This consent is stored in your browser's sessionStorage and is cleared when you close the browser. AI responses are automatically generated and may contain errors. Users use AI responses at their own risk.
